title: Care Desk Authority Matrix — Residential Natural Gas Supply Bill Corrections
content:
The authority of the customer care center over Residential Natural Gas Supply bill corrections rests on two plan terms: how far back a billed line may be corrected, and the largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line.

| Plan | Correction lookback after the line was posted (calendar months) | Agent adjustment limit: largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 12 | 150.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | 12 | 150.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | 12 | 150.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | 12 | 150.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | 12 | 150.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | 12 | 150.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | 12 | 150.00 |

### Authority notes

- The lookback is 12 calendar months on every plan: a billed line may be corrected during the 12 calendar months after it was posted.
- The care agent's limit is 150.00 per line on every plan. A correction of exactly 150.00 is within the limit; a correction of 150.01 is above it.
